description: S9 unit U7 (M7 adapters/monitoring.py source collectors: docker_stats/docker_facts, redis_facts, the eight *_facts wrappers, LaneSnapshotStore/LaneSnapshotTransaction, lane_resolver, lane_session_facts, discovery_pressure_facts and collect; INV-OBSERVATION-001, INV-LANE-SESSIONS-001, INV-FLEET-001, INV-FLEET-BACKLOG-001, INV-HOST-DELIVERY-001, INV-WORKER-SESSION-001, INV-CONTINUATION-001, INV-DISCOVERY-PRESSURE-001), characterized before the move into observation.adapters.collectors with the D1.1 seams: docker over a scripted CLI double (compose and named scope with the substring filter, a missing container, stats, junk lines, non-zero exits), redis over a scripted bus (exists/groups/lag/entries/pending, every call failing), each of the eight wrappers ok and failing with the owner double standing where M7's lazily imported class is (reference) or injected (target), the lane snapshot store over an injected connect double (BEGIN, statement timeout, schema check, ROLLBACK on every path, the put refusal), lane_resolver caching per (lane id, schema), lane_session_facts (unregistered, ok, one lane failing alone, every lane failing, other refusals propagating) and collect (envelope keys and order, every source failing alone and together with distinct error types, named scope, runtime and lanes, the backlog envelope pass-through, the read-only store untouched); mirrors the collect/docker tests of tests/test_monitoring.py, the source-collector tests of test_fleet/test_portfolio/test_research_program/test_worker_sessions/test_discovery_pressure/test_host_delivery_lane_routing as wrapper-level cases and tests/test_monitoring_lane_sessions.py without PostgreSQL. Declared nondeterministic fields are normalized inside the driver, not by the mask list, after being proven within the wall-clock bounds around the call: collected_at, every source envelope's observed_at, each lane's observed_at, the database and observations sources' observed_at and the persisted measurement's default-now age_seconds. No network, container, Redis, PostgreSQL or child process
